description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate detailed, context-aware multiple-choice questions for medical exam preparation, including instructions, explanations, references, and example questions.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive prompt for creating high-quality, scenario-based MCQs based on difficulty, context, and image context, including detailed instructions and response format.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality, accuracy, and appropriateness of a generated MCQ, focusing on correctness, clarity, and scenario realism.
